facebook.caption:
Tourists walk past this place every day. Locals sit down and order Bún Quậy Kiến-Xây.

This is Phu Quoc's own style of noodle soup. Springy hand-rolled noodles, fresh seafood, clear broth. Under $10 a person. 2,697 reviews say it delivers.

Find it at 71A Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. Go hungry. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
